title: Female borrowers who specify the loan amount in local currency fund faster.
Female borrowers who specify a long history of business operation may fund faster.
Female borrowers who mention specific institutional training may fund faster.
Detailed specificity regarding the products or materials being purchased accelerates funding speed for both male and female borrowers.
Female borrowers who provide specific ages for their children may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who mention having a previous loan may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who describe the specific operational benefits of loan inputs fund faster.
Male borrowers who mention a history of previous loan repayment may fund faster.
Female borrowers who include their specific age in their pitch may fund faster.
Female borrowers who provide a specific count of children may fund faster.
Female borrowers who mention the goal of building savings fund faster.
Higher verbosity and excessive personal detail predict slower funding regardless of gender.
Pitches that include specific monthly income figures predict slower funding regardless of gender.
Female borrowers who emphasize that their business is currently doing well or is being sustained fund faster.
Mentioning specific asset or business ownership predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
Mentioning family responsibilities or supporting family members predicts slower funding regardless of gender.
Female borrowers who use aspirational language such as 'dreams' for their business fund faster.
Mentioning a history of previous loan repayment predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
